about: An animated explainer video made for the learner.

cases.text: Can you turn this lesson into a short narrated clip I can watch?
I'd love an animated walkthrough of how a transformer processes a sentence.
Make me a 30 second animated explainer on why the sky is blue.
Produce a short animated clip that shows how gradient descent finds a minimum.
I learn best by watching: could you make a little movie about the water cycle?
Create a narrated animation for explaining binary search to a beginner.
